import json, os, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error
BASE = "https://mott-booking-gw.mail.mybcat.com"
auth = os.environ["GW_TOKEN"].strip()
if not auth.lower().startswith("bearer"):
    auth = "Bearer " + auth

def call(path, payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), method="POST", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": auth, "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:300]

PID, STORE, WANT_START = "4362694474", "711", "2026-08-11T14:00"
st, body = call("/appt-list", {"patient_id": PID, "store": STORE})
appts = ((body.get("result") or {}).get("appointments") or []) if isinstance(body, dict) else []
print("PRE-LIST HTTP %s count=%d" % (st, len(appts)))
for a in appts:
    print("  appt id=...%s start=%s status=%s" % (str(a.get("appointment_id"))[-4:], a.get("start"), a.get("status")))
if st != 200 or len(appts) != 1:
    sys.exit("PRECONDITION_FAIL: expected exactly 1 appointment, got %d (HTTP %s) — refusing to cancel" % (len(appts), st))
a = appts[0]
aid, start = a.get("appointment_id"), str(a.get("start") or "")
if not aid or not start.startswith(WANT_START):
    sys.exit("PRECONDITION_FAIL: appt start %r does not match expected %s* or missing id — refusing to cancel" % (start, WANT_START))
print("PRECONDITION_OK id=...%s start=%s" % (str(aid)[-4:], start))
cs, cb = call("/sign", {"verb": "appt.cancel", "target": aid, "store": STORE, "reason": "patient-request", "params": {"appt_id": aid, "day": start[:10]}})
print("CANCEL HTTP %s %s" % (cs, (json.dumps(cb)[:200] if isinstance(cb, dict) else str(cb)[:200])))
if cs != 200:
    sys.exit("CANCEL_FAIL: gateway returned HTTP %s" % cs)
st2, body2 = call("/appt-list", {"patient_id": PID, "store": STORE})
appts2 = ((body2.get("result") or {}).get("appointments") or []) if isinstance(body2, dict) else []
print("POST-LIST HTTP %s FINAL_COUNT=%d" % (st2, len(appts2)))
if st2 != 200 or appts2:
    sys.exit("POSTCONDITION_FAIL: appointment still present after cancel")
print("CANCEL_VERIFIED")
